text:
alex (product): Quick sync — proposing a small 'Micro Reserved' SKU for pre-seed / Series A startups. Goal: predictable base revenue for low-commit customers while giving them room to burst. Looking for quick RICE + launch criteria input.

mira (sales): +1. Heard this from 3 leads last week. They want predictable spend but can only commit ~$200-300/mo.

leila (finance): Complexity tax alert. Need unit-econ sketch before we go further. What does margin look like at 25k tokens? Forecast ARR if this converts at 5-10%.

simon (eng): From infra side we can do a quota bucket + soft burst. Implementation mostly config + tests. Estimate ~2 sprints for rollout (including e2e). Need to clarify rate-limit semantics for burst.

jordan (cs): Important: migration path from free -> micro reserved should be one-click in Console + templated onboarding email. Also, small customers expect self-serve provisioning.

alex (product): Rough RICE: Reach = medium (big pool of startups but small ARR per customer), Impact = medium-high (reduces churn for early-stage customers), Confidence = low (we need pilots), Effort = small-medium. Propose spike to validate pricing and usage patterns.

mira (sales): I can spin up 4 pilots from our inbound list next month. We can offer a 30-day intro discount to get adoption signals.

leila (finance): Please drop a sample pricing table + assumptions (avg tokens/month, expected overage rate). Also need a rollback if unit cost > price after 90 days.

alex (product): Sample config (proposal):

```
SKU: MicroReserved
commit: 25_000 tokens / month
price: $250 / month
burst: 75_000 tokens (non-guaranteed, best-effort)
rate_limit: 20 requests/min per org, token-cap enforced
overage: pay-as-you-go at $0.004 per 1k tokens beyond commit
```

Policy notes: burst tokens are borrowed from short-term pool and charged at PAYG if exceeded; we mark them best-effort (no SLA).

simon (eng): Implementation sketch:
- Add quota bucket labeled `micro_reserved` with commit window = 30d
- Token-bucket for soft burst with configurable borrow limit
- Rate limit rule higher than free tier but lower than standard paid tier
- Metrics: committed_used, burst_used, overage_charged
- Fallback: if we hit capacity, route to payg throttle with friendly error

alex (product): Suggested launch criteria (must-haves):
- 3 pilot customers signed and using SKU for >=14 days
- Unit economics >=60% gross margin at expected usage
- Console flow + docs + billing flow implemented
- Rate-limit infra validated under 2x expected burst in staging

jordan (cs): Support playbook: onboarding checklist, activation runbook, 2-hour provisioning SLA for paid micro-reserved, escalation matrix. Also sample welcome email for AMs.

mira (sales): Can we add annual commit option (10% discount) and auto-renew opt-in? That helps ARR.

leila (finance): Annual discount OK if we require 12-month minimum or upfront payment. Need churn assumptions for 12-mo cohort.

simon (eng): Timeline:
- Spike (1 sprint): validate burst token-bucket behavior in staging
- Dev (2 sprints): quota + billing hooks + console UI + tests
- Monitoring (1 sprint): dashboards and alerts
Total: ~4 sprints to GA depending on priorities.

alex (product): Next steps: 
- @mira run pilot outreach & share feedback template (due next Wed)
- @leila produce unit-econ scenarios (best/likely/worst) by EOD Fri
- @simon start spike on burst behavior in staging this week
- @jordan draft support playbook + onboarding email
I'll draft a 1-pager PRD after we get pilot commitments. :thumbsup:

mira (sales): On it. sending pilot list into DM now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started by @simon on infra/burst-config spike — build #337

alex (product): Thanks all — flag blockers here. If pilots look good we'll fast-track this into next minor release.
